model.title: Veteran Infection Prevention Act
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Jennifer Kiggans (R-VA)

summary.text: The bill would require Veterans Health Administration sterile processing technicians to hold appropriate professional certifications, aiming to improve infection prevention and safety standards in VA medical facilities.
